quick_skim.title: Watching Synthetic Videos: Aligning Cross-modal Representations with Visual Synthesis for Zero-shot Video Captioning
quick_skim.abstract: Text-only training is a popular paradigm in zero-shot video captioning, where the video distribution is not available to the model during training, leading to a cross-modal gap between the training (text-only) and the inference (video-only). Previous works attempt to bridge the gap through simple linear transformations. However, the inherent gap between text and video makes cross-modal representation space alignment insufficient, resulting in inaccurate sentences. To address this issue, we propose a novel zero-shot video captioning framework (WSV) consisting of two training stages, which first generates corresponding synthetic video latent representations via a pretrained text-to-video generation model. To strengthen the fidelity of the latent representations, we propose a polisher capable of bridging the gap between real and synthetic video distributions. Subsequently, we design a prompter that conditions GPT-2 on the polished latent representations to generate the captions in the second training stage. During inference, an input video is encoded by a pretrained 3D Causal VAE and then fed directly into the prompter, which in turn guides GPT-2 to produce the final caption. Experimental results conducted on MSVD, MSR-VTT, and VATEX datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves scores of 52 and 95.7 on the B@4 and CIDEr metrics, respectively.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Generates synthetic video latents with a text-to-video model to compensate for missing video modality during text-only training, a transferable generative imputation strategy.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 利用文本到视频生成模型合成视频潜在表示，补偿仅文本训练时缺失的视频模态，是可迁移的生成式补全策略。

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: WSV proposes two-stage zero-shot video captioning that first generates synthetic video latent representations via a pretrained text-to-video model, then aligns cross-modal representations to bridge the modality gap from text-only training.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 零样本视频字幕生成的难点是训练时仅有文本、推理时却输入视频，存在跨模态鸿沟。本文提出WSV框架，利用预训练文本到视频模型先生成合成视频潜在表示，再通过两阶段训练对齐文本与视频表示。实验表明该方法生成的语句比简单线性变换更准确，验证了用生成式补全缺失模态的思路。
